description: Rust semantic-search relevance corpus for the egregore codebase. Each query has reviewed expected targets as repo-relative file paths and optional symbol names. Ambiguous queries have no clear correct answer and are used only to count false positives.

queries.text: where are graph records written to the embedded store

expected.note: EmbeddedAletheiaSink write methods persist graph records to AletheiaDB; the concept 'write to store' does not appear in the symbol names

rg_substitute.note: rg can locate call sites for write_node but misses the conceptual boundary between ingestion and storage; it also cannot return Egregore record handles

queries.text: how does the tool measure similarity between two versions of a code file

expected.note: cosine_distance computes the similarity metric; the concept 'similarity between versions' does not appear in the symbol name

rg_substitute.note: rg 'cosine' finds the function but only because the implementation choice leaks into the name; a synonym-based query would not find it

queries.text: which code selects the text that gets sent to an embedding model

expected.note: embedding_candidates selects file and symbol summaries for embedding; 'selects text for model' is absent from the symbol name

rg_substitute.note: rg works only because the symbol name was already chosen to be clear; a natural-language query 'text selection for embedding' would not help rg

queries.text: where does the tool walk through past commits to extract historical code structure

expected.note: history.rs implements Git commit traversal for temporal code extraction; 'walk commits' is absent from file or symbol names

rg_substitute.note: rg 'scan_history' finds the CLI command but misses the actual traversal logic in history.rs; no keyword captures 'walk past commits'

queries.text: where is stable deterministic identity computed for a graph node from its content

expected.note: stable_id computes a hash-based deterministic identifier; 'deterministic identity from content' is absent from the symbol name

rg_substitute.note: rg works if you know the function is called stable_id; the query 'deterministic node identity' cannot be answered by rg without prior knowledge

queries.text: storage backend write path for ingesting records

expected.note: The embedded AletheiaDB adapter is the storage backend; 'backend', 'write path', and 'ingesting' are all synonyms for what the adapter does

rg_substitute.note: rg 'ingest' finds CLI usages but does not identify the adapter module as the conceptual write boundary; rg cannot return a record handle

queries.text: vector similarity retrieval from a knowledge store

expected.note: semantic_search performs HNSW vector similarity lookup; 'vector retrieval from knowledge store' is a synonym-heavy restatement

rg_substitute.note: rg 'semantic_search' works if you already know the function name; 'vector similarity retrieval' cannot be answered by rg without the exact name

queries.text: computing angular distance between two dense arrays of floats

expected.note: cosine_distance computes angular distance (1 - cosine similarity); 'angular distance' is a synonym for cosine distance

rg_substitute.note: rg 'cosine' finds the implementation; 'angular distance' cannot be answered by rg without knowing the name 'cosine'

queries.text: parse source tree and extract structured representation of symbols

expected.note: ir.rs defines the GraphRecord intermediate representation produced by parsing; 'structured representation' and 'symbol extraction' are synonyms for what IR means
rust.rs is where tree-sitter dispatches to extract_function and extract_named_symbol — the actual source-tree parsing and symbol extraction logic

rg_substitute.note: rg 'GraphRecord' finds usages but 'source tree' and 'structured representation' are natural language that rg cannot resolve without the type name

queries.text: time-ordered snapshots of source artifacts across repository history

expected.note: history.rs produces time-ordered (temporal) graph observations across Git commits; 'time-ordered snapshots' and 'history' are synonyms

rg_substitute.note: rg 'scan_history' finds the CLI entry point but 'time-ordered snapshots' cannot be answered by rg without prior knowledge of the feature name

queries.text: which module defines the graph intermediate representation for code nodes

expected.note: ir.rs is the module defining GraphRecord, NodeKind, EdgeLabel, and the entire graph IR

rg_substitute.note: rg 'GraphRecord' finds the type across files; 'which module defines the IR' is a file-level architectural question rg can partially answer

queries.text: where is the adapter interface for pluggable storage backends defined

expected.note: adapters/mod.rs defines the GraphSink trait and adapter traits used by all storage backends

rg_substitute.note: rg 'GraphSink' finds the trait definition; 'pluggable storage adapter interface' is an architectural question rg can partially answer with the trait name

queries.text: which file implements the command line interface and routes subcommands

expected.note: cli.rs contains the Commands enum and all subcommand routing logic

rg_substitute.note: rg 'Commands' finds the enum; 'command line interface routing' is an architectural question that rg can partially answer

queries.text: which module provides the agent-facing graph query helper surface

expected.note: query.rs exposes symbol_at_commit, largest_semantic_drifts, and SymbolContext helpers for agents

rg_substitute.note: rg 'query_symbol' finds call sites in cli.rs but not the module boundary; 'agent-facing query surface' is harder for rg without the module name

queries.text: where is the Git history traversal and temporal extraction implemented

expected.note: history.rs implements commit-by-commit Git traversal without mutating the active checkout

rg_substitute.note: rg 'scan_history' finds the CLI handler but 'Git history traversal implementation' requires knowing to look in history.rs

queries.text: what error is returned when the embedded store directory does not exist

expected.note: validate_existing_embedded_store in cli.rs returns the 'embedded store not found' error and checks for a missing data-dir

rg_substitute.note: rg with the exact error message works; 'what error when store missing' is only answerable by rg if you know the error message text

queries.text: how are deleted records filtered from current-state query results

expected.note: current_deleted_ids in cli.rs collects tombstone IDs; query results exclude tombstoned records
the adapter also filters tombstoned records during semantic search readback

rg_substitute.note: rg 'tombstone' finds filtering logic; 'deleted records filtered from queries' is partially answerable by rg but doesn't return record handles

queries.text: where is tombstone state applied to exclude superseded nodes from search

expected.note: semantic_search in the adapter filters tombstoned and superseded nodes before returning matches

rg_substitute.note: rg 'tombstone_ids' finds the field; 'tombstone applied in search' is partially answerable if you know the field name

queries.text: what path does code take when semantic search finds no matching records

expected.note: query_semantic in cli.rs exits with code 2 and prints a diagnostic when matches is empty

rg_substitute.note: rg 'no results' finds the error message; 'code path for empty semantic results' cannot be answered by rg without the exact message text

queries.text: how to open the embedded AletheiaDB store for reading without holding a daemon lease

expected.note: EmbeddedAletheiaSink::open_unleased opens the store without acquiring a daemon lease

rg_substitute.note: rg works if you know the function name; 'open store without lease' cannot be answered by rg without prior knowledge

queries.text: where is the approximate nearest-neighbour vector index queried for semantic lookup

expected.note: semantic_search calls AletheiaDB's find_similar_by_embedding HNSW query

rg_substitute.note: rg finds the call site; 'approximate nearest-neighbour query' cannot be answered by rg without the method name

queries.text: how graph records are ingested and committed into persistent embedded storage

expected.note: EmbeddedAletheiaSink implements GraphSink::flush which commits all staged records to AletheiaDB

rg_substitute.note: rg 'flush' finds the commit call; 'how records are ingested and committed' is a conceptual question rg can only partially answer

queries.text: where does the scan command serialize extracted graph nodes to line-delimited JSON output

expected.note: the Scan command handler in cli.rs serializes GraphRecord values to JSONL using to_jsonl()

rg_substitute.note: rg 'to_jsonl' finds the serialization call; 'serialize extracted nodes to JSONL output' is partially answerable by rg

queries.text: how are embedding vectors associated with stored graph nodes in the database

expected.note: the adapter writes embedding vectors via EmbeddingVectorKey and stores them alongside the graph nodes in AletheiaDB

rg_substitute.note: rg finds the type; 'embedding vectors associated with stored nodes' requires knowing the type name and cannot be answered by rg from natural language alone

queries.text: which file handles network authentication and authorization for remote services

expected.note: auth.rs resolves GitHub tokens from env vars, token files, and gh CLI — the closed auth enumeration for remote service access
client.rs conditionally attaches Authorization: Bearer headers to outbound GitHub REST requests

rg_substitute.note: rg 'resolve_token' finds the auth entry point; 'network authentication for remote services' cannot be answered by rg without knowing the function name

queries.text: how does the system implement user preference configuration file loading
where does the database apply schema migrations between versions
which module manages HTTP request routing and response handling

expected.note: daemon.rs implements the loopback HTTP server: handle_request routes incoming requests and HttpResponse constructs the reply

rg_substitute.note: rg 'handle_request' finds the routing function; 'HTTP request routing and response handling' cannot be answered by rg without knowing the function name

queries.text: where is the graphical user interface rendered and event loop managed
how does concurrent write coordination prevent data races across threads

expected.note: daemon.rs coordinates concurrent writes via an exclusive StoreLease, Arc<RwLock<EmbeddedAletheiaSink>>, and a bounded mpsc::sync_channel write queue

rg_substitute.note: rg 'StoreLease' finds the lease type; 'concurrent write coordination' cannot be answered by rg without knowing the synchronization mechanism

queries.text: how does the application manage plugin and extension lifecycle registration
which module implements the web frontend rendering and client-side routing
